categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies src/rest.cpp endpoint deserialization.
categories.rationale: Fixes a data correctness bug where POST requests to `/rest/getutxos` fail to find valid unspent outputs due to improper length-prefixed stream deserialization. As noted in the PR description, 'GET finds the unspent output, but POST incorrectly reports no hit', causing false negatives for consumers of the REST endpoint while also patching an unbounded allocation risk on input outpoints.
